name: metamodel.removeProperty
title: Remove property from type
summary: Remove a property from a type that has it itself, while no element of the type or of an inheriting type holds it; its definition goes when no type has it afterwards.
details: The key is removed from the type's own `properties` and `required` lists, in the file the type is in (SR-236 AK3, AK4); a list left without keys stays as `[]`. When no type has the property itself afterwards, its definition is removed from `properties` of the file it is in, with its lines and the comment lines directly above it (SR-238 AK5). An inherited property is removed at the type it is inherited from; a type that lists a property its parent has as well loses its own entry and keeps the property, and `inheritedFrom` names that parent. No element file changes and nothing in Git (D-036); no element is deleted (D-045). Refused while an element file of the type, or of a type that extends it and loses the property, holds its key, also with an empty value, in any status (SR-236 AK7). Saved filters, perspectives and mapping files that name the key of a removed definition are listed in `mentions` and not changed (SR-236 AK7). Errors: input.invalid with details.reason unknown when no type or property has the key (details.type, details.property); input.invalid with details.reason inherited when the type has the property from a parent (details.from); input.invalid with details.reason not-on-type when the type does not have it; input.invalid with details.reason in-use when elements use what the change locks or removes (details.uses: kind, key, count and the short IDs of the first 20 elements in code-unit order); file.faulty when an element file cannot be read, as it may hold the key (details.command, details.files: repository and file); file.folder-missing when such a change needs the uses and a repository of the workspace is not on this machine (details.repository, details.repositories); input.invalid with details.reason metamodel-invalid and the errors in details.problems when the metamodel would have an error; workspace.read-only when the metamodel files do not give a valid metamodel or the metamodel repository is not on this machine; input.invalid with details.reason git-folder when the metamodel folder is .git or a repository of its own (D-036); file.read-only when the metamodel repository cannot be written (SR-018 AK2); file.faulty when a changed definition, or a node on the way to it, holds a YAML alias or anchor (details.repository, details.file, details.line); file.changed-on-disk when another process changed a file since it was read (SR-236 AK10). Nothing is written on these.
whileReadOnlyReason: SR-236 AK5: a metamodel that cannot be read is never changed (SR-011 AK3).

type.description: Key of the type that has the property itself.

property.description: Key of the property to remove from the type.

definitionRemoved.title: Definition removed
definitionRemoved.description: true when no type had the property any more, so its definition was removed (SR-238 AK5).

inheritedFrom.title: Kept from
inheritedFrom.description: The parent type the type still has the property from, when it listed the property as well; absent otherwise.

mentions.title: Files naming a removed key

items.description: Saved filter, perspective or mapping file, relative to the workspace root; not changed.

mentions.description: Saved filters, perspectives and mapping files that name a removed key as a mapping key or text value, except their own name and description (SR-236 AK7).

items.description: Written file, relative to the workspace root.

versionsChanged.title: Versions changed
versionsChanged.description: Elements whose version is another under the new metamodel (SR-015 AK4): elements of a type whose counted properties change and that have a value for one of them, such as elements of a type that was unknown before; those of `versionsChangedElements`.

missingRequired.title: Missing required properties
missingRequired.description: Elements that now miss a value of a required property they did not miss before (SR-015 AK3); those of `missingRequiredElements`.

versionsChangedElements.title: Elements with another version
versionsChangedElements.description: The elements `versionsChanged` counts, in store order.

missingRequiredElements.title: Elements missing a required property
missingRequiredElements.description: The elements `missingRequired` counts, in store order.

problems.title: Problems
problems.description: The warnings of the metamodel afterwards (SR-236 AK1).
